programme.title: Daring Danger
programme.desc: Tim McCoy is nearly killed in a fight with Alexander. He recovers and goes after him.

programme.title: Unknown Valley
programme.desc: A cowboy goes into the desert to find his father, but is captured.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: Two brothers return home at the end of the war to find their family has been kidnapped by Confederate forces.

programme.title: The Return Of Daniel Boone
programme.desc: The grandson of Daniel Boone foils a land deal by two moneygrubbers.

programme.title: Riders Of Black River
programme.desc: A Former Texas Ranger returns to his home town to find that the territory is in the grip of cattle rustlers.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: Banker Martin Raikes heads to Monaco to investigate strange financial activity surrounding a film production that his bank is financing. There he encounters the film's star, the washed-up, hard-drinking one-time action star Jake Mellows. Before he can conduct a thorough investigation, Raikes finds himself framed for the assassination of a government official. With both crooks and the law out to get him, Raikes goes on the run, eventually hooking up with Mellows.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Love Again
programme.desc: Amidst a distant relationship with his father and losing his girlfriend to his best friend, Nathan's brokenness leads him on a journey of rediscovering hope and a healing heart to love again.

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: When objects start to go missing from her home, Sophie Hartley (Susan Sarandon) suspects that a stalker is responsible. Then she meets Mara (Emily Blunt), the new co-worker of her husband, Craig (Sam Neill), and after seeing her in a dress that was among the vanished items, Sophie believes that Mara is obsessed with her. Unfortunately, she takes her suspicions too far, which leads to legal ramifications and her husband becoming concerned for her well-being -- but also to a startling discovery.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A corrupt businessman commits a murder and the only witness is the girlfriend of another businessman.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: Knight George (James Purefoy) returns to England for a peaceful life after the Crusades. But first he promises King Edgar (Simon Callow) to find his missing daughter, Princess Luna (Piper Perabo), in exchange for a plot of land. George discovers the princess has been taken by a dragon, which apparently died after laying an egg. But Luna refuses to abandon the unhatched dragon, so George must return both princess and egg to the king -- while avoiding Luna's determined fiancé (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: Comment séduire un prince
programme.desc: À New York, une conseillère en rencontres amoureuses tente de séduire un prince qu'elle accompagne dans le milieu des rendez-vous galants.

programme.title: Des voisines presque parfaites
programme.desc: Deux familles sont déchirées par la disparition de leurs filles et partent à la recherche de celles-ci.

programme.title: Mariage à l'indienne
programme.desc: Vivi demande l'aide de Raina pour changer son destin amoureux, mais Bhumesh, le fils de Raina, pourrait être le changement attendu.

programme.title: Meurtre, richesse et décadence
programme.desc: La directrice adjointe d'un club de golf découvre que des activités illégales ont lieu sur son lieu de travail.

programme.title: Born Free
programme.desc: The true story of Joy Adamson and her husband, George, who adopt a slain lioness' cubs.

programme.title: The Solid Gold Cadillac
programme.desc: A lowly stockholder exposes a big company's corrupt Board of Directors.

programme.title: The Game That Kills
programme.desc: A man joins a professional hockey team to find out who killed his brother in a faked rink accident.

programme.title: The Heroes Of Telemark
programme.desc: The leader of the Norwegian underground is enlisted by British intelligence to aid in destroying a factory.

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: Hoping to escape from his troubled past, former DEA agent Phil Broker moves to a seemingly quiet backwater town in the bayou with his daughter. However, he finds anything but quiet there, for the town is riddled with drugs and violence. When Gator Bodine, a sociopathic drug lord, puts the newcomer and his young daughter in harm's way, Broker is forced back into action to save her and their home. Based on a novel by Chuck Logan.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. Seo Eungi was born as the daughter of a giant corporation's president and raised to be the successor. As they all work for their dreams, Maru gets a call from Jaehui. Eungi's life also changed since that day. The lives of the three people flow in an unexpected direction.

programme.title: I Can Hear Your Voice Ep.1 (English Dub)
programme.desc: There's a boy who can hear peoples thoughts. 10 years ago, a boy witnessed his father getting murdered during a car accident. The accident was to frame a murder. Since then, he can read the minds of other people by making eye contact with them.

programme.title: Innocent Defendant Ep.1 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Jung Woo is a prosecutor who lives an exciting life, fighting homicide crimes hands on. On his daughter's sixth birthday, he happens to deny a job offer that gets him locked up behind bars for reasons he can't seem to recall, after experiencing short term amnesia. He finds out from his fellow inmates that he killed his wife Ji Soo and daughter Ha Yeon. Dazed and confused, Jung Woo fights for his freedom.

programme.title: Money Flower Ep.1 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Pil-joo is the lawyer and fixer for Cheong-A Group, one of Korea's leading conglomerates. Bu-cheon is the unstable heir to the Cheong-A throne. To place Bu-cheon in power as Cheong-A's rightful successor, Pil-joo begins executing a meticulously crafted plan...

programme.title: Haechi Ep.3
programme.desc: Prince Yeoning decides to testify at the Supreme Court of Saheonbu. He confesses that he substituted for Tae Pyeong at the state exam and asks to be exiled for this crime. The officials, however, do not want to believe his accusations of Prince Milpoong. The Head of Saheonbu decides to arrest Prince Milpoong, and everything seems to go as planned.

programme.title: Haechi Ep.4
programme.desc: King Sukjong calls the Chief Inspector and orders him to help him make Prince Yeoning king. Meanwhile, the Patriarchs have decided to support Prince Yeonryeong. The Minister of Personnel persuades Prince Yeoning to withdraw his testimony and indict Jeong Seok for instigating false testimony. Prince Yeoning feels hopeless about the whole situation and has to testify again.

programme.title: Haechi Ep.5
programme.desc: The Crown Prince has become king but does not win respect because of a lack of an heir. He is powerless at court. Meanwhile, Prince Yeoning meets the Minister of Personnel to tell him that Prince Milpoong probably killed Prince Yeonryeong, but the Minister is only interested in solidifying political power. The Patriarchs scheme with prisoners and let them escape, but Prince Yeoning sees through it.

programme.title: Haechi Ep.6
programme.desc: Yeo Ji and her colleagues find out that Prince Yeoning had been supporting them all along. It's finally the day the exam results are announced, and Moon Soo fails to find his name on the list. He is certain that there is corruption going on surrounding the state exam. Inspector Yoon Hyeok knows about the corruptions but can't find a way to investigate them. This changes when he meets Park Moon Soo.

programme.title: Haechi Ep.7
programme.desc: Prince Yeoning returns to his former colleagues Park Moon Soo and Yeo Ji and tells them he was behind the investigation on exam corruption. Prince Yeoning is now determined to become king. But the Minister of Personnel meets with the king and tries to persuade him otherwise. Meanwhile, the Patriarchs manipulate public opinion so the exam corruption case won't attract too much attention. And the Saganwon is out to stop the king from putting pressure on the Patriarchs.

programme.title: Haechi Ep.8
programme.desc: Chang Joong and Yi Gyeom meet the king to recommend Prince Yeoning as the Crown Prince. Meanwhile, Moon Soo and his colleagues notice that Yeo Ji isn't back after she left to talk to the students. It turns out the assassins sent to kill Prince Yeoning were ordered by Prince Milpoong and not Min Jin Heon. The widowed Queen recommends Prince Yeoning, and the king, after some doubt, orders Prince Yeoning be made Crown Prince.

programme.title: Haechi Ep.9
programme.desc: The Qing is rumored to dealing in the human trafficking of girls from Joseon. Yeo Ji is recruited as an undercover investigator on the case. Prince Yeoning is unhappy at Yeo Ji being constantly in danger. Meanwhile, Moon Soo, as a new member of Saheonbu, is trying to endure all the hard training. The palace officials show that they don't acknowledge the Crown Prince by not showing up at the Prince's first-morning lecture.

programme.title: Rebirth Ep.19
programme.desc: Episode 19As Detective Kyung slowly recovers, he searches for Ha-eun, who continues to hide his identity. Tae-jun and In-cheol track down clues about Min Soo-yeon, while Dong-chan is threatened over a past case. Meanwhile, Kang-joo faces pressure over her investigation, and Ha-eun secretly moves Kyung to safety—where Kyung takes his hand and calls him “Kang-hyuk.”

programme.title: Rebirth Ep.20
programme.desc: After learning that Detective Kyung has disappeared, Tae-jun and Sang-guk pressure Dong-chan, fearing the truth may be exposed. While searching for Kyung, Dong-chan is suddenly attacked by Park Sang-chul and hospitalized. Meanwhile, Jin-woo uncovers signs of stock manipulation involving the Star Hotel and begins suspecting deeper corruption tied to J&C. As business conflicts intensify and alliances crack, Eun-ha remains firm in rejecting Jin-woo, while a bracelet resurfaces—bringing her one step closer to the truth about Ha-eun.

programme.title: Rebirth Ep.21
programme.desc: Detective Kyung confirms Ha-eun's true identity, while Eun-ha also begins to realize the truth after recognizing a meaningful bracelet. As secrets unravel, Dong-chan blackmails Tae-jun and Sang-guk with evidence of past corruption, and new threats emerge from Park Sang-chul. Unable to suppress his emotions any longer, Ha-eun finally confronts Eun-ha, setting the stage for a turning point.

programme.title: Rebirth Ep.22
programme.desc: Shocked after discovering Ha-eun's hideout, Eun-ha begs him to forget everything and return to the past, but he asks her to trust and wait. As Sang-guk and Tae-jun grow fearful of a hidden third party, Dong-chan escalates his threats, while financial pressure mounts on Jin-woo. Meanwhile, Detective Kyung prepares to return and gathers key testimony, as long-buried truths about Ha-eun's identity and In-cheol's secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: Rebirth Ep.23
programme.desc: After learning of In-cheol's role, Ha-eun is shaken but finds brief comfort with Eun-ha. As Hee-soo discovers that Min Soo-yeon is his mother, he hesitates to leave and seeks the truth about his past. Meanwhile, Mi-jung hands over evidence of Sang-guk's corruption, and Yang Man-cheol's wife delivers proof of Dong-chan's threats. As Kang-joo uncovers that Steven Lee is actually Hee-soo and confronts Tae-jun, the real Steven Lee suddenly appears—while Ha-eun finds a crucial letter left behind before Im Dae-sik's death, bringing him closer to the truth.

programme.title: Rebirth Ep.24
programme.desc: In-cheol confesses to killing Ha-eun's father to cover up corruption and keep Lee Hwa, urging Ha-eun to walk away. As betrayals unravel and the truth is exposed to the world, Tae-jun, Sang-guk, and the others face the collapse of everything they built. Confronted with his identity and past, Hee-soo spirals toward revenge, and all those entangled in the conspiracy head toward inevitable ruin.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Egg jangjorim is perfect when you need a quick side dish to complete your meal. The taste is richer and less salty than regular beef-based jangjorim. You can easily finish a bowl of rice with this addictive dish only.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A road trip experience in Korea is not complete without a stopover at a highway rest stop. One of the classic foods available at these stops is the hearty Gyeongsang-do Province style spicy beef soup packed with Korean radish and bean sprouts. Another delicacy is rice cakes with sausages skewered together and glazed with spicy sauce.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gukbap is one of the delicacies in Busan made of pork bone broth and pork slices served with rice. The origin of this delicious and hearty treat dates back to the Korean War when refugees made a broth out of pork bones which were more readily available than ox bones.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Tofu is an affordable source of protein and a versatile ingredient in Korean cuisine. Dubu gangjeong is pan-fried crunchy tofu tossed in sweet and sour sauce. Even kids who don't like eating tofu will enjoy this healthy and savory dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Highway rest stops in Korea are a great place to enjoy local delicacies. An example would be kkomak bibimbap in Boseong which is a bowl of rice topped with chubby cockles and assorted vegetables and served with spicy sauce. Other popular foods found at rest stops include hot bar, a fish cake bar made from white fish fillet, squid and vegetables.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Spring is in the air with trees and flowers bursting into life. What better season to have a picnic with your family and friends? We have prepared some quick and easy recipes featuring seasonal ingredients that you can try at your next picnic, including rice balls, bacon-wrapped rice cake, fresh fruits and strawberry juice.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make danhobakjuk, a sweet pumpkin porridge. Boiled sweet pumpkin is simmered with glutinous rice flour and garnished with chewy little rice cake balls and a few pumpkin seeds. As the temperature drops, there's nothing like this comforting dish to warm you up. With its rich flavors, danhobakjuk truly captures the taste of autumn.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Bomdong, or spring cabbage, signals the arrival of spring. Rich in vitamin c, these greens are sweet and savory. When added to the doenjang soybean paste soup, bomdong leaves help remove sodium in the paste, while giving a refreshing kick. Try these recipes to liven up your spring table!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Fish cake and noodles simmered in a savory broth is a popular and filling food at rest stops. After indulging in the hearty soup, try roasted butter potatoes with a crispy outside and a tender inside.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Dried pollock fish, bean curd and bean sprouts are simmered in a rich stock to make a hangover soup great for breakfast. After indulging in this tasty and filling soup, try a deep fried spiral-cut whole potato on a skewer. These two delicacies will keep you fueled for the rest of your trip.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: During the May 18 Democratization Movement, a popular uprising against the military regime in Korea in 1980, women made jumeokbap, or rice balls to feed the freedom fighters. The food became a symbol of solidarity and sharing. Try these recipes that will help us remember the spirit of the watershed moment in Korean democracy.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make bibim makguksu, or spicy buckwheat noodles that are sure to light up your appetite this spring. Cold, springy buckwheat noodles are topped with fresh vegetables and fruits and a spicy sauce. We will make the traditional Korean version, as well as the international version that uses ingredients that are more readily available elsewhere in the world.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Fall crabs packed with meat are tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce. These spicy raw crabs are known as “rice thief,” as your bowl of rice will be gone in no time. Another delicious recipe that uses a seasonal ingredient is a hearty and refreshing soybean sprout soup made with seasonal oysters.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Eggplants are summer vegetables rich in Vitamin E. If you are not a big fan of their mushy texture, try gochujang gaji deopbap with lightly stir-fried eggplant tossed in spicy chili paste. A perfect dish to pair up with it is oi naengguk, a refreshing summer soup made of cucumbers that are known to cool body heat due to high moisture content.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: The gizzard shad is one of the most popular seasonal fish in fall. It is braised in a spicy and sweet sauce to make a delicious fish dish that is sure to light up your appetite. Pair it with steamed lotus root tossed with perilla seeds, another delicacy made of seasonal ingredients.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Spicy noodles are a perfect dish to beat the heat and bring back your appetite. Top it with kimchi made of young summer radish for a crunchy and refreshing flavor and serve with pickled Korean melon, another dish made of a seasonal ingredient.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Rice meets the season's best ingredients – chewy and juicy pyogo mushrooms and sweet Korean radish – to make a savory rice dish. Make sure to serve it with a spicy soy sauce for an extra kick. A great dish to pair with it is spicy steamed scallops, made of assorted vegetables and fresh scallops which are in season in fall with plump meat and a sweet taste.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Sujebi, or a hand-torn noodle soup, is one of the most popular easy-to-make recipes. The food began to gain popularity after the Korean War which left the country in shambles. South Korea received flour from the U.S. as food aid, and people cooked it to relieve their hunger instead of rice. Couple this noodle soup with a Korean lettuce salad to commemorate the anniversary of the Korean War.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Yullan is a traditional Korean dessert made by mashing freshly harvested fall chestnuts and mixing them with honey and cinnamon powder. Another popular Korean dessert is fried and sugar coated sweet potatoes that are soft inside and crispy outside. Pair them with a sweet and refreshing smoothie made of persimmons that are in season in fall.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Pizza toast with a variety of toppings and melted mozzarella is a satisfying and tasty snack for kids. Pair it with a refreshing salad made with assorted fruits and vegetables and tossed with a creamy mayonnaise-based dressing.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Japchae, or stir-fried glass noodles, is a staple in Korean parties and holidays. For this new take on the classic recipe, glass noodles are served with fresh, crunchy vegetables to make a delicious cold dish that is great for a low-calorie diet. Try it with steamed zucchini stuffed with tofu for a nutritious and visually satisfying meal.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Sambok means the three hottest days of summer in Korea, with the two of them falling in July. There is a tradition to eat nourishing food to beat the heat on these sambok days. One of the most popular dishes of this kind is samgyetang, or a bowl of whole chicken in a broth simmered with milk vetch roots, jujubes and garlic. Serve it with kkakdugi, or cubed radish kimchi, for a refreshing bite.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chicken chunks braised in sweet and savory soy sauce are one of the most popular delivery food items in Korea. The fresh vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots and onions make the dish much more enjoyable. Pair it with rice balls made of flying fish roe and chopped Korean pickled radish. You can enjoy the rice balls plain or dip them in the braised chicken broth for an extra kick.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: High in protein, potassium and phosphorus, brown croaker fish is known to help boost energy and beat fatigue in the summer. The versatile ingredient can be eaten raw, cooked in soup or braised. Another great way to enjoy it is to top it over rice in a stone pot. Try this healthy fish recipe with pickled onions and radishes to whet your appetite on a hot summer day.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make kimchi bokkeumbap, or rice stir-fried with chopped kimchi and vegetables. Made of the beloved Korean staple, this fried rice is easy and quick to make. The chef uses leftovers in the fridge to whip up this all-time favorite recipe, including day-old rice, sour kimchi, and bacon strips. Treat your family to this comforting and savory dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: One of the most popular late night delivery food items in Korea is tteokbokki, or spicy stir-fried rice cakes. Adding fresh seafood can give this iconic dish an extra rich flavor. programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jul. 27 this year marks the 70th Anniversary of the Korean War Armistice Agreement. The ceasefire was meant to be a temporary measure until a peace treaty is reached, but it never came, and the Korean Peninsula is still in armistice. In this episode, we will make Pyeongyang naengmyeon, a cold noodles dish popular in both sides of the border, to remember the painful chapters of Korean history.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA

Chunks of juicy tender chicken are braised in spicy sauce to make the savory dish perfect for a year-end celebration.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: No Korean New Year's celebration is complete without tteokguk, or rice cake soup. In fact, Koreans consider themselves a year older when eating a bowl of tteokguk. programme.title: Karen Rontowski
programme.desc: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world. Her stand- up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

programme.title: Bengt Washburn
programme.desc: Bengt Washburn is an Aquarius with Hazel eyes who prefers boxer briefs, solid deodorants, and Crest toothpaste. He is 5'9? tall, weighs about 149 pounds and can bench 150 pounds three times without a spotter. He has a vertical leap of 16 inches. 8 years ago a lump appeared on his right thigh. It's not visible from the stage but according to some kids at the water park, it looks creepy. Many people say Bengt looks kind of like a monkey. Bengt Washburn was born in Salt Lake City, Utah but grew up in a large Utah town (1,200 people) as the fifth child in a small Mormon family (7 children). Bengt is married to an officer in the United States Airforce. They have lived in 6 different cities over the last eleven years. Most recently he moved to Springfield, Virginia (Washington D.C.) after living in Stuttgart, Germany for 3 years. Bengt is a former winner of the prestigious San Francisco International Comedy Competition. He has been seen on The Late Late Show with Craig Fergusen, Live at Gotham on Comedy Central and most recently Conan on TBS. He was invited to perform at the Vancouver International Comedy Festival, The Boston Comedy Festival, the Aspen Laff Festival and Gilda's Laugh Fest in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He's been heard on NPR, PRI and Bob and Tom. All three of his comedy Cd's can be heard playing on XM Sirius radio. Most people who know him would say Bengt is a logistically impaired ditz, but his comedy is described as intelligent, surprisingly universal considering the content matter and profoundly funny.

programme.title: Paul Morrissey
programme.desc: Paul was raised as a sports fanatic in the tiny town of Owego, in upstate New York. After four years of playing college basketball, somehow he graduated. Aside from playing in the NBA, his dream job was to talk about sports for a living. Paul then moved to California after landing a television sports anchor job but found out quickly that he was “too much of a smart-ass” for TV news. After he was fired, Paul took his unique sense of humor to comedy club stages all over the country. In 2005, Paul was selected to perform at the HBO Comedy Festival in Las Vegas. Morrissey has also been a finalist in several national comedy competitions including Wendy's Comedy Challenge, Comedy Central's Open Mic Fight and Maxim's Real Men of Comedy.

programme.title: Key Lewis
programme.sub-title: Half Black, Half White, Looks Mexican
programme.desc: Sacramento California born Key Lewis is a high energy, improvisational, storytelling, multiple-personality nutcase! His love for the people and hunger for the stage is his undying motivation. His comedic stories about his interracial childhood, family, and unusual views on relationships, make Key simply a joy to watch. His ability to improvise and interact with all types of crowds makes this up and coming comic and actor one to look out for. Key Lewis has appeared on Marlon Wayans TBSís Funniest Wins, Starz Networks StaannDup, Kevin Harts One Mic Stand as well as Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes! Key says, chase your dream, always know your audience donít act funny, be funny... donít worry about the quantity of your material but the quality the sooner you create a relationship with your crowd, the better you will be. Television: Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes on TVONE. BETíS One Mic Stand Hosted by Kevin Hart. Starz Network Comedy Series called StaannDup, Marlon Wayanís TBSís Funniest Wins! Competitions: Winner of the 2013 Rocky Mountain Laugh Off, Finalist in the 2010 Bay Area Black Comedy Competition, Semi-Finalist 2009 San Francisco International Comedy Competition, a Semi-Finalist in the 2008 Boston Comedy Festival, 2007 Seattle International Comedy Competition Finalist, Shades of Laughs Portland Oregon Winner, TVONE Bill Bellamyís Who Got Jokeís Contestant. Radio: Improv work with FM Morning Shows (Top 40 Radio): KSFM 102.5 (Sacramento, CA), KWOD 106.5 (Sacramento, CA) KWIN 97.7 ñ Stockton/Lodi, CA, Mix 107.9 Salt Lake City UT (Is It Racist Segment) & The Man Panel. Concerts/Festivals: Opened for Jon B. and Keysha Cole, Taste Of Tacoma, & Bite Of Seattle Fountain Stage 5 Years Running! Key Lewis has worked with the likes of Kevin Hart, Pablo Francisco, Sam Bam, Alonzo Bodden, Jay London, Gabriel Iglesias, Brooks McBeth, Tommy Davidson, Katt Williams, De-Ray Davis, Andrew Norelli, Lonnie Love, Jeff Garcia, Damon Wayans, Joey Diaz, Guy Torry, Darren Carter, Paul Mooney, Kermet Apio and many more.

programme.title: Tom Clark
programme.desc: Tom Clark was born and raised, in that order. Clark's mix of well-crafted jokes and spontaneous crowd work has led to appearances on TBS's ‘Conan,' CBS's ‘Late Late Show, and Comedy Central's ‘Premium Blend'. Clark has traveled coast to coast doing stand up and has performed internationally as part of New Faces at the prestigious‘Just For Laughs Comedy Festival' in Montreal and on The Main Stage at ‘The Capetown Comedy Festival' in South Africa. Clark is also an actor and has appeared on such shows as NBC's ‘Outsourced', TNT's ‘The Closer',and the Hallmark made for TV movie ‘The Wish List'. After landing the role on ‘Outsourced,' director Ken Kwapis invited Clark to be in the Drew Barrymore movie, ‘Big Miracle'. You can also see Clark in Columbia Pictures ‘Freaks of Nature.'

programme.title: BT
programme.sub-title: My Life As I Know It Now
programme.desc: With an act that crosses all boundaries, B.T. will surely have you rolling with laughter. His physical performance style and charm landed him two performances on NBC's Friday Night Videos and a performance at the prestigious HBO U.S. Comedy Arts Festival. B.T. has also appeared on BET's Comic View, MTV's The Jenny McCarthy Show, and FOX's The Keenan Ivory Wayans Show.

programme.title: Johnny Beehner
programme.desc: Johnny Beehner puts on a funny show. He's got everything you want from a comic: He's silly, he's likeable, and he's fun. With a background in improvisational theater including training at Chicago's prestigious Second City, as well as the Upright Citizens Brigade in Los Angeles, Johnny brings a unique style to the stage. Beehner made his network television debut in January of 2015 as one of the last comedians to appear on the Late Show with David Letterman. He has made numerous appearances on FOX "Laughs" television show, and regularly appears on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Show. His comedy can be heard regularly on XM/ Sirius Satellite radio. Other notable and accomplishments of Johnny's include winning First place in Comcast's 2014 season of "Trial By Laughter," placing third in the 2014 “Laughing Skull Comedy Festival” of Atlanta, and making it to the finals in the 2012 “Great American Comedy Festival”. He was named one of Ricky Gervais' Top 5 picks in the "Just Sayin” stand up contest. Johnny was recently named one of 2015's Top10, "Hot Comics to Watch" by his wife. She says that he would have a shot at the #1 spot if he would “work just a little bit harder”. He's a married man, a new dad, and his current life goal is to win just one argument with his beautiful wife.

programme.title: Michael Mossman
programme.sub-title: Munich Philharmonic Hall: Michel Camilo Quintet
programme.desc: Well-known for his exuberant style and intimate familiarity with a vast range of jazz and Latin idioms, Michel Camilo has always had a sixth sense for musical adventure. Camilo was one of the most stimulating jazz pianists to emerge in the mid- to late '80s. His powerful two-handed attack (full of impressive technical skills), his knowledge of both jazz and Afro-Cuban music, and his willingness to constantly take chances turn each of his solos into an adventure. This broadcast was taped during the 1991 Münchner Klaviersommer, when Camilo was playing with his amazing Quintet. He is accompanied by Ned Mann (bass), Cliff Almond (drums), Michel Mossman (trumpet and trombone) and Ralph Bowen (saxophone and flute). Camilo's rise to fame has been swift, and his influences range from jazz musicians like Art Tatum and Keith Jarrett to twentieth-century composers like Debussy and Ravel.

programme.title: Ted Curson
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Seun Kuti
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti's legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent. Three-quarters of Egypt 80's current line-up is composed of musicians who didn't only play with Fela Kuti, but often were arrested and harassed alongside the founder of the Afrobeat.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Duke Ellington
programme.sub-title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves' outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington's career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world. Less than a year before his death, Ellington and his Orchestra, with Gonsalves still in the fold, appeared in Brussels to deliver a timeless performance before a highly appreciative crowd.

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Iván Fischer
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Lesley Garrett, Wiener Akademie, Alfred Eschwe & David Charles Abell
programme.desc: A Night in Vienna recreates the magical atmosphere of 19th century Viennese ballrooms. In the breathtaking surroundings of Vienna's Hofburg Palace, the Wiener Akademie period orchestra, conducted by Alfred Eschwe, plays some of the Strauss family's and Joseph Lanner's favorite pieces, including "The Beautiful Blue Danube", "Tritsch-Tratsch-Polka", and the "Radetzky March". Former residence of the Habsburg dynasty, the Hofburg contained the apartments of Emperor Franz Joseph and Empress Elizabeth. A Night in Vienna features soloist Lesley Garrett, the most popular soprano from the UK. The spirit of the Strauss era is perfectly recreated by the addition of waltz dancers adorned with historical costumes. This concert was presented in 2004, under the direction of David Amphlett.

programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: 100 JOURS AVEC LES SECOURS
programme.desc: Médecins, infirmiers ou ambulanciers, ces professionnels de l'urgence ont un seul objectif : arriver le plus vite possible sur les lieux d'un accident pour secourir et accomplir les bons gestes. Les missions des médecins urgentistes ne se ressemblent jamais. A la gravité des situations, s'ajoutent également les difficultés du terrain. Direction la Côte d'Azur pour suivre ces professionnels au cours de leurs interventions. A Nice, les médecins doivent notamment transférer une petite fille souffrant de troubles respiratoires jusqu'à Milan en jet privé médicalisé.

programme.title: FLIC STORY
programme.desc: Le quotidien des brigades de police, suivi par une équipe de reportages. Entre poursuites en voitures, interventions en ville, opérations anticriminalité, aucune opération de police ne ressemble à une autre. Dans l'exercice de leurs fonctions, les représentants de l'ordre doivent déployer de nombreuses compétences, comme résoudre les conflits entre voisins. En France, près d'un habitant sur deux affirme avoir eu maille à partir avec des personnes de son voisinage. Un focus est fait sur la travail des agents et sur les moyens dont ils disposent pour désamorcer les différents conflits.

programme.title: 100 JOURS AVEC LES GENDARMES D'AIX-EN-PROVENCE
programme.desc: Aix-en-Provence dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, à quelques kilomètres de la Méditerranée. Un décor de carte postale qui fleure bon le soleil et les vacances mais derrière ces paysages de rêve se cache une autre réalité. Entre fous du volant, drogue et violences familiales, les forces de l'ordre sont en alerte. Pendant plusieurs mois nous avons suivi ces militaires sur le terrain. Notamment le PSIG, le peloton de surveillance et d'intervention de la gendarmerie spécialisé dans les interventions musclées. La nuit, ils sont en première ligne face à la délinquance. Particulièrement le week-end, de grandes fêtes clandestines occasionnent de nombreux dérapages, la tension peut vite grimper entre fêtards et gendarmes. Un quotidien pas toujours de tout repos, nous avons également suivi la brigade de Gardanne. Les gendarmes sont sur tous les fronts entre soirées familiales qui virent au règlement de compte et excès en tous genres. Enfin, sur les routes, la brigade motorisée d'Aix-en-Provence fait régner l'ordre. Chaque jour, ils font face à des amateurs de vitesse en quête de sensations fortes prêts à prendre tous les risques. Plongez dans le quotidien mouvementé des gendarmes d'Aix en Provence.

programme.title: SEULS FACE A L'ALASKA

programme.title: SEULS FACE A L'ALASKA
programme.desc: En Alaska, nos trois trappeurs luttent contre les caprices de la nature alors que l'hiver approche. Tom doit mettre son travail entre parenthèses pour trouver de quoi se nourrir avant la fin de la saison Eustace va chercher de l'aide auprès d'une ancienne connaissance pour prendre sa relève et au coeur de la forêt, Marty n'arrive pas à trouver assez de fourrure pour que son commerce soit rentable.

programme.title: SEULS FACE A L'ALASKA
programme.desc: Dans les montagnes en Alaska, l'Homme n'est plus le principal prédateur. Tom Oar est obligé de prendre les choses en main pour repousser les loups dangereux loin de sa propriété. Pour Eustace, l'eau vient à manquer sur l'Ile de la Tortue Marty doit être prudent car en Alaska, une simple une erreur pourrait lui faire perdre tout ce qu'il possède !

programme.title: SEULS FACE A L'ALASKA

Des proches qu'il a tués d'un coup de fusil, avant de les massacrer à la hache. Sans état d'âme et sans le moindre regret. Pire, à son procès, il est allé jusqu'à expliquer que c'était lui la victime ! Victime de reproches incessants. Victime du manque de reconnaissance de ses patrons qui voulaient le mettre à la retraite.

programme.desc: Es gibt Tage, die fühlen sich wie Übergänge an. Tag 205 ist so einer – ohne große Bewegung, aber auch nicht stehengeblieben.

programme.title: Alles beim Alten? | Tag 206 Staffel 5 I Big Brother
programme.desc: Der Tag beginnt ruhig, wie gewohnt. Doch hinter scheinbarer Wiederholung steckt oft Veränderung im Kleinen. Tag 206 schaut genau hin.

programme.title: Bootsdrama und heiße Cheerleader?!
programme.desc: tress pur! Robert und Carmen Geiss machen mit ihren Kindern und dem neuen Boot eine Spritztour. Doch plötzlich passiert es... Robert fährt auf eine Sandbank! Um sie herum nur Felsen und flaches Wasser. (S6 E04)

programme.title: Horror-Trip nach St. Barth!
programme.desc: Auch in Florida ist das Wetter schließlich manchmal schlecht – und so etwas kommt bei den Geissens gar nicht in die Tüte! Daher verlassen Carmen und Robert Miami in Richtung Karibik. (S6 E05)

programme.title: Romantik in der Karibik: Carmen Geiss schwebt auf
programme.desc: Die Geissens finden in der Karibik eine einsame Insel. Carmen Geiss überlegt kurzerhand, einfach mit der Yacht abzuhauen... Aber dann kommt alles anders - denn Robert hat eine Überraschung für sie! Carmen schwebt sofort auf Wolke 7. (S6 E06)

programme.title: Chaos pur: Reinhold Geiss bringt alle auf die Palme!
programme.desc: Robert und sein Vater Reinhold Geiss waren mit den Kindern "angeln". Leider ohne Erfolg. Die schnelle Lösung: ein Fisch vom Fischmarkt. Doch Carmen Geiss kann man nicht so leicht täuschen... (S6 E08)

programme.title: Auf den Spuren von Jennifer Lopez und Enrique
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich heute mit einem Kapitän, der ihnen das Gebiet rund um Miami zeigt. Doch Carmen Geiss' Stimmung ist direkt zu Beginn schon auf dem Tiefpunkt. Zum Glück ist für Ablenkung gesorgt: Ist das etwa die Villa von Jennifer Lopez? (S6 E09)

programme.title: Auf Wolke 7: Robert Geiss übertrifft sich selbst!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss verbringt die Weihnachtszeit in New York! Zuerst steht natürlich Shoppen bei Macy's auf dem Programm. Im Anschluss hat Robert Geiss noch etwas ganz Besonderes organisiert: einen Helikopterflug über die Lichter der Stadt. (S6 E10)

programme.title: Absolut wild: Reinhold Geiss riskiert sein Leben!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet den Everglades-Nationalpark in Florida. Doch dort wimmelt es nur so von wilden Alligatoren! Die möchten natürlich auch gefüttert werden! (S6 E11)

programme.title: WOW! Carmen Geiss lässt heiße Poolbilder machen...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss hat eine ganz besondere Überraschung geplant! Und dafür macht sie sich ausnahmsweise sogar die Haare nass! Unsere Lieblingsmillionärin möchte heiße Pool-Bilder für ihren Göttergatten Robert Geiss schießen lassen. (S6 E12)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens besuchen den Freizeitpark WonderWorks in Orlando. Erst testen sie einen Hurrikan-Simulator, dann geht es zum Indoor-Sky-Diving. Während die Kinder vorlegen, wagt Carmen den Sprung in den Windkanal. (S6 E14)

programme.title: Scharfes Fotoshooting: Carmen Geiss posiert mit
programme.desc: Heute steht das große Roberto-Geissini-Shooting an - und Robert Geiss hat diesmal richtig dick aufgetragen: bunte Harleys, heiße Models und eine brandneue Kollektion. (S6 E15)

programme.title: Inflagranti erwischt?!
programme.desc: Das gibt Ärger. Die Kinder und Robert haben Carmen Geiss' Wagen "verschönert". Noch bevor Robert Geiss die Situation retten kann, kommt sie plötzlich um die Ecke. Zum Glück hat sie kaum Zeit, sauer zu werden - denn es geht direkt ins Tonstudio. (S6 E16)

programme.title: Mega-Fail beim Poker Run in Miami!
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss wurden zum Speedboot-Event Poker Run in Miami eingeladen. Die Mission: Mit ihrer Donzi von Spot zu Spot fahren, an jeder Station eine Spielkarte sammeln und am Ende mit dem besten Pokerblatt gewinnen. (S6 E17)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens starten eine abenteuerliche Fahrt mit der Donzi. Damit alles gut geht, haben sie einen erfahrenen Kapitän mit an Bord, denn überall lauern Sandbänke. Und dann passiert das Unvermeidbare: Robert und Carmen Geiss sitzen plötzlich fest! (S6 E18)

programme.title: Horror im Keller: Carmen Geiss ist plötzlich
programme.desc: Robert Geiss macht ordentlich Dampf und schickt Carmen Geiss in den Keller, um die Koffer zu holen. Überall warten Klamottenberge darauf, verstaut zu werden. Aber wo bleibt Carmen? (S6 E19)

programme.title: Nichts geht mehr! Totalschaden bei Geissens'
programme.desc: Nach der Rückkehr aus Miami ist es in Monaco eisig kalt und das totale Chaos bricht aus! In der Tiefgarage steht sie kurz vorm Nervenzusammenbruch - kein einziges der heißgeliebten Luxusautos will anspringen! Nur der Maserati läuft… (S6 E20)

programme.title: Hat Robert Geiss heimlich eine Yacht gekauft?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss fliegt mit dem Helikopter von St. Tropez nach Monaco – und weiter nach Alicante. Dort wartet schon Robert Geiss' neues Projekt: ein riesiges Luxusboot. Doch auf der Yacht wird geschraubt, gehämmert und Möbel werden verschoben. (S6 E21)

programme.title: Couch über Bord: Carmen Geiss flippt aus!
programme.desc: Eigentlich wollten Carmen und Robert Geiss in Alicante die Renovierungsfortschritte auf ihrer neuen Yacht inspizieren. Doch plötzlich treibt Carmens Couch einfach im Hafen! Während Robert das Ganze gelassen sieht, ist Carmen kurz vorm Explodieren. (S7 E01)

programme.title: Mega Hausbesichtigung auf Ibiza!
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss tauchen in die Welt der Luxusimmobilien ein. Eine der sündhaft teuren Immobilien ist eine riesige Villa auf Ibiza. (S1 E01)

programme.title: Kindergeburtstag-Desaster bei den Geissens
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss scheuen keine Kosten und Mühen, um einen riesigen Kindergeburtstag für Shania zu veranstalten. Doch einige Dinge scheinen den beiden einen Strich durch die Rechnung zu machen. Wird der Geburtstag trotzdem stattfinden? (S1 E02)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss' rockt mit Jürgen Drews die Bühne
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss verbringen ihren Urlaub auf Mallorca und treffen dabei keinen Geringeren als ihren Freund Jürgen Drews, den "König von Mallorca". Überwindet Carmen ihr Lampenfieber und traut sich mit auf die Bühne? (S1 E03)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss im Shopping-Wahn
programme.desc: In Saint Tropez ist Sommerschlussverkauf und Carmen Geiss ist im Shopping-Wahn - als Frau kann man schließlich nie genug Kleidung haben. Robert ist hingegen nicht so begeistert vom Shopping-Fieber seiner Frau... (S1 E04)

programme.title: Back to the Roots
programme.desc: Bei Carmen und Robert Geiss steht eine Reise in die Vergangenheit an: es geht zurück in ihre Heimatstadt Köln. Robert ist allerdings kein Fan von Deutschland - für Carmen wird es hingegen emotional. (S1 E05)

programme.title: Wahrsagerin zu Besuch!
programme.desc: Davina und Shania Geiss überraschen ihre Eltern mit dem Besuch einer bekannten Wahrsagerin. Was wird die Zukunft der Geissens bringen? (S1 E06)

programme.title: Überraschungs-Fail!​ Carmen Geiss ist enttäuscht
programme.desc: Robert Geiss möchte seine Frau Carmen in Cannes überraschen. Allerdings hat Carmen sich die Überraschung etwas anders vorgestellt… (S1 E07)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens starten eine Weltreise mit der ganzen Familie. Erster Halt: Athen. Da darf ein Besuch der Akropolis natürlich nicht fehlen. Carmen hat dabei ihre ganz eigene Zeitrechnung… (S2 E01)

programme.title: ​Mega Gönnung in Dubai & Skifahren bei 40 Grad
programme.desc: Für die Geissens darf ein Halt in der Luxusstadt Dubai auf ihrer Weltreise natürlich nicht fehlen. Ski fahren bei 40 Grad, ein Wettrennen durch die Wüste und Kamelreiten an einem Tag? Kein Problem für Familie Geiss. (S2 E02)

programme.title: Employee Fakes Sick To Skip Work
programme.desc: Jacob, a compulsive liar, fakes his grandma's death to skip work for a date with his boss's daughter, Nicole. His web of lies unravels when both grandmas appear, exposing his deceit and costing him his job, his girlfriend, and his dignity.

programme.title: Caught Cheating On Drivers Test
programme.desc: Tim, a spoiled teen, cheats on his driving test using his dad's Tesla, but his schemes unravel. After hitting a car and failing, he's arrested, and his furious dad refuses bail, leaving Tim to face the consequences alone.

programme.title: Girl Bullied for Being Wrestler
programme.desc: Riley secretly wrestles while her mother pushes for a traditional life. After her boyfriend issues an ultimatum, she chooses her dream, earns her mother's support, and begins training with a pro.

programme.title: Teacher Gets Revenge on School Bully
programme.desc: After his teacher helps him transform from a scrawny victim to a confident student, Miles realizes his bully, Grant, is hiding a painful home life. Miles records evidence of Grant's abusive stepfather, helping Grant find safety and redemption.

programme.title: Scrawny Teen Takes Pills to Beat Bully
programme.desc: Scrawny Ethan is pressured to take steroids by a corrupt coach. Choosing hard work over shortcuts, he trains with the school janitor to beat his bully in a showdown and expose the coach's crimes.

programme.title: Toxic Friends Don't Know Friend Is Secretly Famous
programme.desc: After being bullied for his weight and mocked for his dream of stand-up, lawyer Jonah quits his job. Guided by comedian Lauren, he finds success and proves his toxic friends and ex-girlfriend wrong.

programme.title: Girl Is Dumped Then Becomes a Millionaire
programme.desc: After her fiancé Alex fires her and leaves her for her best friend, Hannah seeks revenge by teaming up with his estranged brother, Logan. She finds true success and love where she least expected it.

programme.title: Police Show Up at House at 2AM
programme.desc: After his "Frank the Prankster" persona ruins his personal life, Frank tries to frame Dhar Mann for a crime. However, Dhar outsmarts him with a "prank-back," ultimately rewarding Frank with a date.

programme.title: Genius Kid Is Expelled From School
programme.desc: Underestimated due to autism, Jayden uses his engineering genius to save his school from a major crisis. His mother's "white lie" about a cruel letter gives him the confidence to prove his true worth.

programme.title: A TikTok Prankster Goes Too Far
programme.desc: Frank "the Prankster" records his escalating pranks on classmates for TikTok fame, causing chaos and damage. When his biggest prank targets the principal, he's caught on camera by his victims. This leads to Frank facing consequences, ultimately apologizing, learning that actions have consequences.

programme.title: New Cool Kid Steals Shy Kid's Girl
programme.desc: Middle schooler Kyle's jealousy over new student Archie threatens his chance with crush Candace. Guided by his father Darrel, Kyle faces his insecurities. He apologizes, and both Kyle and his parents reconcile their relationships at the school dance.

programme.title: Girl Kept in Attic from Evil Stepmom
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Cindy is abused and drugged by her greedy stepmother, Julianne, who plots to steal her inheritance. Cindy's teacher and a mysterious stranger expose Julianne's crimes just in time.

programme.title: 22-Year-Old Goes Back to High School
programme.desc: To fund her sister's surgery, Vietnamese immigrant Minh poses as a teen to attend free high school. Exposed by a bully, she find support in a friend and eventually secures her dream career.

programme.title: Orphan Teen Mistreated by Foster Family
programme.desc: Abandoned by his mother and abused in foster care, homeless teen Mike is taken in by the wealthy Burgess family. They help him excel in football and academics, leading to his rise as an NFL legend.

programme.title: Mean Girls Shame Teen for Anime Cosplay

In ihrem idyllischen Refugium veredeln sie Wildgerichte mit eigens angebauten Kräutern. Die Zubereitung erfolgt auf einem Holzofen, denn Strom und Wasser sind in dieser abgelegenen Gegend rar.

programme.title: GEO Reportage
programme.desc: Der Spreewald, nur eine knappe Autostunde von Berlin entfernt, ist ein Naturparadies, durchzogen von unzähligen Kanälen und Fließen. Manche Orte sind sogar nur auf Kähnen passierbar. Ein verwunschener Landstrich, der mit einem ganz eigenem Zeitgefühl und alten Bräuchen gestresste Großstädter magisch anzieht.

programme.title: Dance Academy, Season 1 S01 E11
programme.desc: Tara is excited when Ethan asks her to star in his choreography assessment piece, but Ethan only has eyes for his mentor, Dana. Abigail's sister, Paige, stays for the weekend.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E01
programme.desc: A girl is home alone on a full moon when she hears a noise outside... She bravely goes to see what it is and is confronted by two wolves escaping from INSIDE her house! She controls them back into the cellar - her eyes flashing golden - who is this girl? She's Maddy Smith and she's a wolfblood. Maddy meets her friends Tom and Shannon at school.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E02
programme.desc: Maddy's mum Emma is worried about Rhydian growing up in care, with no wolfblood support. She wants to invite him around for dinner to teach him about wolfblood ways and how they fit into human society. Shannon has proof at last! She has a photo of a wolf and puts posters up of it all over the school.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E03
programme.desc: It's the school art exhibition and the theme is family. Rhydian puts up a picture of a lonely boy, with silhouettes of parents in the distant background. He storms out when the 3 Ks comment on it. Tom has put up loads of pictures of him and his dad at football matches, he is excited that his dad is coming to the exhibition.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E04
programme.desc: Maddy's got her exams coming up, but she isn't feeling very well and is grouchy - her first change is coming... Tom reminds her she forgot to help him with his English revision for the exam tomorrow and she promises to make it up to him at break but at break she is struggling pre-change and Rhydian takes her for a run to blow off steam.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E05
programme.desc: It's full moon tonight and Maddy is anxious about her first transformation, but also bursting with the energy that a full moon brings. The school are on a day trip to the historic isle of Lindisfarne, but Maddy and Rhydian are feeling cramped in the ancient stoney ruins and are not looking forward to spending the night in the den...

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E06
programme.desc: The wolf energy is still strong in Maddy's blood, she gets carried away in assembly watching the street dance club and joins in with their routine. She is fantastic, (which puts Kay's nose right out of joint!). Everyone now thinks Maddy is cool, especially Dean Samuels, the cutest boy in school!

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E07
programme.desc: When there is no moon, wolfbloods become lethargic and are stripped of their powers. Tomorrow is no moon and Maddy and Rhyidian aren't looking forward to it! Stuck in detention, mischievous Maddy decides to have some fun and gets Rhydian to join in. Whilst Mr Jeffries slips out they take the school trophy and hide it on the school roof - Maddy accidentally cuts herself whilst doing this.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E08
programme.desc: Animals have been going missing around the village and Shannon thinks that the beast is back. Instead of having their movie night, she wants them to all go beast hunting. At first Maddy isn't keen to go, wanting a wolf free night, but when Shannon tells Maddy that her mum is sending her to a psychiatrist because of her beast fixation, Maddy agrees to go.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E09
programme.desc: It's the night before full moon and Rhydian is spending a practice night in the Smith's den. The next day on their way to school Maddy and Rhydian sniff out some stolen goods -Sinclair gear hidden in the woods! They take a few t-shirts for themselves, Tom and Shannon. Shannon doesn't want a t-shirt as they aren't ethically made, but the 3 Ks overhear and start bartering for the spare t-shirt.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E10
programme.desc: Maddy, Rhydian, Tom and Shannon are playing in the woods when Tom notices someone spying on them. Maddy and Rhydian catch their scent - the wild wolfblood is back... Bernie, who owns the local village shop, fills them in about a homeless women who has been sleeping rough in the woods.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E11
programme.desc: Rhydian is dabbling with his Eolas powers in school, showing off to his school mates. Maddy can't understand how he is doing it, the tricks go beyond Wolfblood senses and speed. Rhydian shares his secret with Maddy. It's something his mum taught him, Eolas, which wild wolfbloods use to connect themselves with nature.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E12
programme.desc: It is the day of the full moon and Maddy and Rhydian aren't looking forward to a night in the den. Rhydian tries to talk Maddy into escaping, but Maddy knows she can't - her parents would be furious! Shannon has been trying to forget about the beast by throwing herself into other interests.
